paths.description: Public homepage and principal service-discovery surface; tested as the global shell and first task entry point.
Institution-services listing, representing the large directory/listing archetype.
Search results for “pasaport”, representing query, filters, result discovery, and onward navigation.
Accessibility information page, representing long-form informational content.
Public four-step document-verification form, representing a primary transactional flow and invalid-input recovery.
Linked identity-provider login, representing authentication choices, account entry, cancellation, and recovery.
English locale variant, representing localization and translation behavior.

findings.summary: No user-preference-driven dark theme
findings.evidence: The dark-mode screenshot is pixel-identical to the default capture, and the computed root color-scheme is “normal”.
findings.suggestedFix: Declare color-scheme and provide a prefers-color-scheme/light-dark() palette for page, controls, and imagery.

findings.summary: Reduced-motion preference does not suppress non-essential entrance motion
findings.evidence: Under prefers-reduced-motion: reduce, the header and search block still run 1 second fadeIn/fadeInDown animations and many 0.3–1 second transitions remain active.
findings.suggestedFix: Add a prefers-reduced-motion: reduce override that removes entrance animations, auto-advance, and non-essential transitions.

findings.summary: High-contrast preference produces no adaptation
findings.evidence: The prefers-contrast: more screenshot is unchanged from the default capture and no adaptive color-scheme is declared.
findings.suggestedFix: Use prefers-contrast and forced-colors-safe styling so controls, indicators, and focus remain distinct.

findings.summary: Route and state changes do not use View Transitions
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no view-transition CSS despite the browser API being available; observed route changes are full abrupt navigations.
findings.suggestedFix: Progressively enhance same-document and cross-document route changes with the View Transitions API and reduced-motion handling.

findings.summary: Fixed navigation is not scroll-state aware
findings.evidence: DOM/computed evidence shows a fixed header, while the platform probe found no container/scroll-state rules or scroll timeline; the header does not adapt to page position.
findings.suggestedFix: Use scroll-state container queries or a lightweight progress/shrinking-header treatment to preserve content space and orientation.

findings.summary: Transient menus rely on custom JavaScript positioning
findings.evidence: The document-verification share menu is registered through edPopover JavaScript; the platform probe found no CSS anchor positioning rules or native popovers.
findings.suggestedFix: Use popover plus CSS anchor positioning and position-try fallbacks for attached menus.

findings.summary: Responsive behavior is viewport-only rather than component-aware
findings.evidence: The representative pages reflow on mobile, but the platform probe found zero @container rules and computed container-type remains normal.
findings.suggestedFix: Introduce container queries for reusable cards, search/filter panels, and service modules while retaining viewport fallbacks.

findings.summary: Numerous interactive targets are too small for reliable touch
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports 13 target-size failures; the direct probe found 44 visible interactive elements below 24 px in one dimension, including 11×11 carousel controls and 16 px-high footer links.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase targets or spacing to at least the WCAG target-size baseline, preserve visible focus, and ensure hover affordances have touch/keyboard equivalents.

findings.summary: Mobile loading performance misses the good LCP range
findings.evidence: Lighthouse measured LCP 4.7 s, FCP 3.6 s, and performance 0.74; the separate trace measured LCP 2.46 s, showing variability around/above the good threshold.
findings.suggestedFix: Prioritize the LCP asset, reduce document/server latency, and remove avoidable critical-path work; verify with repeat mobile traces.

findings.summary: Parser-blocking resources lengthen the critical path
findings.evidence: The HAR summary identifies two VeryHigh-priority stylesheets and four classic parser-inserted head scripts without async/defer/module; the DOM confirms these script attributes are absent.
findings.suggestedFix: Defer non-critical classic scripts, inline only essential critical CSS, preload only proven LCP dependencies, and keep cache policy explicit.

findings.summary: The page ships measurable unused CSS and JavaScript
findings.evidence: Lighthouse estimates 22 KiB unused JavaScript and 11 KiB unused CSS on the homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Split page-specific bundles and load conditional dependencies only on surfaces that need them.

findings.summary: An interactive link’s accessible name does not match its visible label
findings.evidence: Lighthouse flags the my.gov.az link because its aria-labelledby name omits the visible URL/new-window text.
findings.suggestedFix: Make the accessible name include the visible label, and keep supplementary new-window text in the name without replacing visible content.

findings.summary: Multiple text styles fail WCAG contrast
findings.evidence: Lighthouse found seven contrast failures, including #4284be text on white/grey (3.32–3.98:1) and white text with a low-contrast teal text shadow.
findings.suggestedFix: Adjust text and surface tokens to meet at least 4.5:1 for normal text and retest all themes/states.

findings.summary: The homepage lacks a main landmark
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports landmark-one-main failure, and the homepage DOM has zero <main> elements even though internal templates do use one.
findings.suggestedFix: Wrap the homepage’s primary content in one main landmark and retain the skip-link target and logical headings.

findings.summary: Touch target sizing undermines inclusive reflow
findings.evidence: The 360 px layout itself has zero horizontal overflow, but Lighthouse reports 13 target-size failures across the reflowed homepage.
findings.suggestedFix: Increase target dimensions/spacing in narrow and zoomed layouts without disabling user scaling.

findings.summary: Image delivery lacks robust intrinsic and responsive sizing
findings.evidence: The image audit found 26 of 35 images without width/height, 15 oversized images, 14 without responsive sources, and 24 legacy-format resources (including placeholders/icons).
findings.suggestedFix: Add intrinsic dimensions, srcset/sizes, lazy loading for below-fold content, and appropriately sized modern assets.

findings.summary: The homepage is not eligible for back/forward cache
findings.evidence: Lighthouse reports one BFCache failure reason, reducing instant restoration on back navigation.
findings.suggestedFix: Remove the reported BFCache blocker or scope it to the page lifecycle, then verify back/forward restoration in DevTools.

findings.summary: Localized public pages omit canonical and hreflang signals
findings.evidence: The probe found no canonical and zero hreflang links despite Turkish and English variants; robots and sitemap are otherwise present and permissive.
findings.suggestedFix: Publish self-consistent canonical URLs and reciprocal hreflang annotations for Turkish/English variants.

findings.summary: Rich entity metadata stops at Open Graph
findings.evidence: The homepage exposes four Open Graph tags but no JSON-LD for the government organization/site or search action.
findings.suggestedFix: Add accurate schema.org JSON-LD for GovernmentOrganization/WebSite and relevant SearchAction/breadcrumb entities.

findings.summary: Security headers and cookie posture are weaker than expected for a national identity portal
findings.evidence: HTTPS and nosniff are present, but HSTS is absent, CSP permits unsafe-inline and unsafe-eval, Referrer-Policy is unsafe-url, and all five first-party cookies use SameSite=None.
findings.suggestedFix: Enable HSTS, move inline/eval code to nonce/hash-based CSP, tighten Referrer-Policy, and use Lax/Strict cookies unless cross-site behavior is demonstrably required.

findings.summary: Defensive browser policies are incomplete
findings.evidence: The header audit found no Permissions-Policy and neither X-Frame-Options nor CSP frame-ancestors; CSP also lacks Trusted Types/origin-isolation protections.
findings.suggestedFix: Set frame-ancestors, a least-privilege Permissions-Policy, stricter referrer handling, and evaluate Trusted Types/COOP for sensitive surfaces.

findings.summary: Core interaction requires JavaScript despite server-rendered content
findings.evidence: Discoverability shows 100% raw-content coverage, but the authored noscript message states e-Devlet requires JavaScript and core form behavior is script-dependent.
findings.suggestedFix: Keep server-rendered content and make search/basic form submission work without scripting; layer enhanced validation and widgets on top.

findings.summary: The app-like public service has no installable/offline web fallback
findings.evidence: The platform probe found no web app manifest and the homepage exposes no service-worker registration path, despite being a high-use app-like portal.
findings.suggestedFix: Provide a manifest and a minimal service worker offline shell explaining connectivity and preserving safe retry/navigation.

findings.summary: The English locale remains partly untranslated
findings.evidence: The English variant correctly sets lang=en, but its first 1,000 characters still include Turkish labels such as “Ana Sayfa”, “Ana Bölümler”, banner copy, and “Yeni Sekmede Açılır”.
findings.suggestedFix: Complete translation coverage and test locale switching across shared shell, dynamic banners, and assistive text.

findings.summary: Locale-sensitive content does not fully adapt to English
findings.evidence: The English route retains Turkish tax-period text and date wording instead of localized number/date content.
findings.suggestedFix: Render dates, numbers, and dynamic campaign copy with locale data and Intl APIs rather than carrying Turkish strings into English.

findings.summary: Key identity and verification inputs disable autofill
findings.evidence: The public verification field and both login identity/password fields explicitly use autocomplete=off; the login form itself is also autocomplete=off.
findings.suggestedFix: Use correct autocomplete tokens such as username and current-password; keep sensitive actions protected through reauthentication rather than blocking password managers.

findings.summary: Asset sizing creates avoidable transfer waste
findings.evidence: The image audit found 15 oversized images, 27 below-fold images without native lazy loading, and 14 images without srcset.
findings.suggestedFix: Serve responsive modern images at display-appropriate sizes, add intrinsic dimensions, and lazy-load non-critical images.

findings.summary: Font and CDN transfer cost is high for a mostly informational first view
findings.evidence: The 760 KB homepage load includes 10 font requests totaling 254 KB and 51 cross-origin CDN/analytics requests totaling about 750 KB, though no known commercial tracker was detected.
findings.suggestedFix: Subset/consolidate fonts, reduce variants, and set a proportionate first-view resource budget while retaining the controlled CDN.

findings.summary: High-value government tasks are not exposed as structured agent capabilities
findings.evidence: The probe found no WebMCP surface; agents must infer search and verification semantics from page markup even though raw content is crawlable.
findings.suggestedFix: Pilot narrowly scoped, confirmation-gated WebMCP tools for low-risk search and document-verification affordances.

taskList.title: Harden transport, CSP, cookies, framing, referrer and permissions policies
Fix contrast, landmarks, accessible names and touch target sizing
Restore autofill and password-manager support on identity inputs
Improve LCP and critical resource delivery
Add dark, reduced-motion and high-contrast preference adaptations
Make core search and verification progressively enhanced and provide offline recovery
Complete English localization and locale-aware dynamic content
Optimize responsive images, fonts and page-weight budget
Add canonical/hreflang and structured entity metadata
Adopt component/position/transition platform primitives where they improve continuity
Pilot safe structured agent capabilities for public low-risk tasks
